issue_context.title: Alpha Vantage API rate exceeded on free tier.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Alpha Vantage API calls on free tier is limited to 25 per day. Documentation states 5 queries per minute.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.1.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Alpha Vantage

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alpha_vantage/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

comments:
> "We are pleased to provide free stock API service covering the majority of our datasets for up to 25 requests per day.", from https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key

The integration polls every 5 minutes (not configurable). 25 requests multiplied by 5 minute is 125 minutes, or a fraction more than 2 hours. So with a free plan, your daily consumption will be reached in under 2.5 hours with just one stock.

Plausibly the integration _could_ be reduced to a maximum of once per hour, with a configurable parameter for polling.

That said, with this new limit and pricing the integration is likely to become useless for most people (unless you are [prepared to pay up](https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/)).
is it possible to make the poll-interval configurable?
